briefing: Markets were mixed and essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 +0.0%), showing no clear risk-on signal. With only $89.29 in cash — well below the $500 threshold needed for a new position — and no forced-buy setup present, the agent held all 7 existing positions and made no new trades.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines rather than invested, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today the portfolio had almost no spare cash and the market gave no strong signal, so the disciplined move was to hold existing positions rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資者保留在場邊、尚未投入市場的現金，待出現理想機會時再部署。今天投資組合幾乎沒有閒置現金，市場亦未釋出明確訊號，因此紀律性的做法是繼續持有現有部位，而非勉強進行交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today, with the NASDAQ slipping slightly and the S&P 500 essentially unchanged, reflecting a lack of strong conviction from investors in either direction. Without a clear catalyst pushing markets higher or lower, trading stayed quiet and directionless. This kind of low-volatility, sideways action is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日主要指數窄幅波動，納指小幅下跌，標普500指數則幾乎持平，反映市場對後市方向缺乏明確信心。在沒有重大利多或利空消息的推動下，成交氣氛偏向觀望。這種低波動、橫盤整理的走勢，在缺乏重大經濟數據或財報公布的空檔期頗為常見。
